description: Invalid or expired tokens are rejected and expired token cleanup is observable.

cases.description: A request with an already expired token is rejected by the protected HTTP endpoint.
A request with a token shorter than the lookup key length is rejected by the protected HTTP endpoint.
A request with a modified token value that cannot match the stored digest is rejected by the protected HTTP endpoint.
When authentication encounters expired sessions for an account, those expired sessions are removed from persistent storage.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/logout/
request.status=401
request.url=/api/logout/
request.detail=Invalid token.
tokens_before=10
tokens_after=0

cases.description: When an expired token is encountered during authentication, the expiration notification includes the affected account identifier.
cases.expected_output:
route=/api/
request.status=401
request.url=/api/
request.detail=Invalid token.
tokens_before=1
tokens_after=0
expired_signal_called=true
expired_signal_username=john.doe
expired_signal_source=auth_token
